create_xverse_causal_lm: create an XverseForCausalLM model with HuggingFace config and optional quantization config
build_xverse_decoder_layer: build an XverseDecoderLayer with config, layer id, and quantization config for transformer inference
run_xverse_model_forward: run the XverseModel forward pass with input ids, positions, and forward batch tensor

test_xverse_attention: test the XverseAttention module with qkv projection, rotary embeddings, and radix attention
